title: Strands tracing tests (cross-version-tests): assert token usage through _core_token_usage, not exact CHAT_USAGE dicts, because strands 1.54+ adds cache-token keys
answers: Why do the strands autolog tests fail on strands 1.54.0 with a token usage dict mismatch?
How should a strands tracing test compare CHAT_USAGE or trace token_usage when the supported strands range spans old and new versions?
Where is the helper that trims strands token usage to input, output and total tokens?
body:
Path: tests/strands/test_strands_tracing.py:_core_token_usage is the test-side helper that normalizes a span's CHAT_USAGE attribute and a trace's info.token_usage before comparing them; it covers strands autolog single-agent and multi-agent tracing tests run by the cross-version-tests job across strands 1.7.1 through latest.
Rule: Compare usage with _core_token_usage(...) == {input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens} instead of comparing the whole usage dict. strands >= 1.54 also emits cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens (typically 0), which MLflow's gen_ai translation copies into CHAT_USAGE and the aggregated trace token_usage whenever present.
Symptom: On strands 1.54.0 the scheduled cross-version-tests run for the strands / autologging job went red, because test_strands_autolog_single_trace and test_multiple_agents_single_trace asserted an exact 3-key usage dict and got 5 keys.
Constraints: Use this only for the core token counts; do not drop cache keys from assertions that specifically check cache behaviour. The helper currently indexes each core key directly, so a strands version that omits a core key raises KeyError rather than a clean mismatch; filtering by key presence is the more robust form (review suggestion). Token counts themselves must still be asserted unchanged.
applies: Tests under tests/strands that assert MLflow token usage recorded from strands spans; the cross-version range is strands 1.7.1 to latest.
says: Strands autolog tests fail on strands 1.54 with a token usage dict mismatch
Strands tracing test reports extra cache token keys in usage, breaking exact comparison
Token counts in strands tracing tests should compare only input, output and total tokens
Cross-version strands tests go red after 1.54 because of cache token fields
Keep cache token assertions only where cache behaviour is actually tested
search: Strands tracing tests compare token usage through a core-token helper instead of exact usage dicts, because strands 1.54 and later add cache-token keys. Use it only for core token counts; keep cache keys in assertions that check cache behaviour. Token counts must stay unchanged.
